programme: Fortune Corpus Novelty & Assurance Programme v1.0

N1_novelty.pass: Every priority A/B candidate has a closest-known-result record, an exact-difference statement, and one of NEW/STRENGTHENING/NEW_SPECIALIZATION/KNOWN_SPECIAL_CASE/ROUTINE_DERIVATION/UNCLEAR. No NEW or STRENGTHENING verdict may be based on search absence alone.
N1_novelty.fail: Any headline novelty claim lacks a documented comparator or collides with prior work under equal/weaker hypotheses.

A1_axiom_closure.pass: The FortuneFormal package contains zero axiom declarations used by Papers I-VII, zero sorry/admit, full lake build passes, and Paper VII K2 emptiness remains derivable.
A1_axiom_closure.partial: CertificateStatement becomes axiom-free but genuine Datum-to-model normalization remains external.
A1_axiom_closure.fail: The external normalization boundary is mathematically stronger than the committed certificate or requires an unproved new theorem.

P4_paper_iv.pass: Independent recomputation reproduces every coefficient pattern, multiplicity, contour loss, exceptional-character moment bound, matching class, and final log exponent with nonnegative slack.
P4_paper_iv.fail: Missing pattern, multiplicity mismatch, unproved character estimate, or final exponent exceeds the stated budget.

P6_paper_vi.pass: Every theorem in the quotient/trace chain is independently rederived or tied to an explicit cited theorem with hypotheses verified for the present object.
P6_paper_vi.fail: Any cross-disciplinary step is analogy-only, circular, or uses a theorem outside its hypotheses.

P7_paper_vii.pass: Inverse-free algebraisation, common defect, zero-defect classification, q-free certificate, genuine normalization, and quadratic contradiction all independently reproduce.
P7_paper_vii.fail: Any implication from genuine incidence to q-free model or from certificate to arithmetic contradiction fails.

R_portfolio.pass: Surviving headline results are mapped to a publication structure with no known-special-case theorem marketed as new and specialist review packets are generated.
R_portfolio.fail: Portfolio structure still depends materially on unresolved novelty or proof status.
